team: Dead heat on Saturday: Fred 17:47 and Will 17:51 on the stations 5 to 8 half sim, and Fred says he lost about 15 s before pressing stop. Same Monday numbers too (trap bar 205 lb, hack 150 lb). Shared gaps: both ran 5.2 of 9 km and neither did Friday.

fred.headline: Knee back to zero, now show up Friday
fred.summary: Four of five sessions: Mon, Tue (done Wednesday after a logged rest day), hockey and the half sim, with Friday swapped for a rest day for the second week running. Knee pain never went above 1, down from 5 last week, and average RPE eased from 7.8 to 7.5. Run volume was 5.2 of 9 km, and the sim came in at 17:47 at RPE 8 (week 2 sim splits have ghost laps, so judge it by the total and your 2:58 first run).
strengths: Knee recovered: 0 to 1 all week, including hockey at RPE 8
Monday is moving: trap bar 205 lb at RIR 2 (top set 95 per side) and hack squat up to 150 lb at RIR 3+
8 x 400 m all done, 2:15 down to 1:52, and laterals hit 4 x 12 at 17.5 lb as planned
weaknesses: Friday missed two weeks in a row: no pull ups, bench, face pulls or engine EMOM logged yet
Run km 5.2 of 9 (no Sunday run, no extra easy km)
400 m reps spread 23 s (1:52 to 2:15); the fast one in the middle cost you the last three
tips: Trap bar: your sets ramped 185, 205, 235 lb. After warm ups, do all 3 working sets at 215 lb so the progression is clean.
Week 3 Tuesday is 5 x 600 m: aim for about 3:10 each (5:17 per km) and keep all five within 5 s of each other. Even pacing is what wins the 8 race runs.
Weekly body weight average 158.7 lb vs 157.4 lb in week 1, stable. Keep both Monday and Thursday weigh-ins. Book the MCL assessment before week 9 even though the knee feels fine.

tweaks.text: Do Friday this week, even short: pull ups and DB bench 3 x 5 plus face pulls 3 x 15, and only drop the finisher EMOM if time runs out.
Hack squat goes to 170 lb after two weeks at RIR 3+; keep the EMOM sled push at 190 lb since the feel was 10 to 20 s.

will.headline: Big jump on Monday, Friday went missing
will.summary: Four of five sessions: Mon, Tue, hockey and the half sim; Friday was not logged and there is no rest day to explain it. Monday was a huge step up from 90 lb to 205 lb on the trap bar at RIR 1, and the half sim came in at 17:51 at RPE 8, level with Fred. Run volume was 5.2 of 9 km, average RPE 5.8, and knee peaked at 3 on Monday.
strengths: Trap bar 205 lb and hack squat 150 lb, both 3/3 at RIR 1
Very even treadmill reps: 2:22 to 2:34 per 400 m, 12 s spread
Sim 17:51 at RPE 8, right with Fred
weaknesses: Friday skipped, after doing only 2 of 5 exercises there last week
Intervals too easy: RPE 3 at 10 km/h (6:00 per km), you said yourself lots of rest between reps
Run km 5.2 of 9, and only Monday weigh-ins (no Thursday)
tips: You wrote the sled push was not heavy enough with lots of time left: go to 175 lb on Monday. Lunges had no time left, so keep their pace and do not add weight there yet.
Week 3 Tuesday is 5 x 600 m: set the treadmill to 11 km/h at 1% incline (about 5:27 per km). If RPE is still under 5, go to 11.5 next time.
Arms: laterals at 15 lb and curls at 22.5 lb were both RIR 0, so repeat them until all sets feel like RIR 1. Add a Thursday weigh-in so the weekly average means something.

tweaks.text: Do the full Friday: assisted pull ups at 70 lb assistance (lower it to 65 if RIR is 2 or more), DB bench 3 x 5 at 45 lb, face pulls and cable crunch, then the EMOM.
Knee hit 3 last Monday: if it is 4 or more in the warm up, swap the EMOM lunges for step ups.
